_readme: Packaging, pallet and trade terms. tools/build-grade-pages.py reads this
for the packaging strip on each grade page. The same figures appear on
index.html and wholesale.html by hand, each marked with a
<!-- TODO(packaging) --> comment so they can be found and changed together.
EVERY FIGURE HERE IS A PLACEHOLDER except the two bag weights, which the
brief specifies. The pallet configuration (60 bags / 1,200 lb) is a guess
from the brief and must be confirmed against the actual pallet build.
